arxiv.abstract: Tasks such as quadrotor dynamic-gate racing require agents to anticipate external motion while maintaining precise high-frequency control. arxiv.title: Progress Probes $P^2$: Lightweight Runtime Monitoring for Vision-Language-Action Models
arxiv.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can perform diverse manipulation tasks directly from visual observations and natural language instructions, but they remain prone to mistakes and unpredictable failures. arxiv.title: Humanoid Mobility via Attention-based Contacts
arxiv.abstract: Humanoid mobility over complex terrain requires accurate foot placement and coordinated whole-body motion capable of robust adaptation. arxiv.abstract: Recognizing task completion and failure enables robots to stop upon success and initiate recovery or replanning after failure. arxiv.abstract: Objective: Iontophoretic drug delivery has primarily relied on current modulation to regulate drug transport. Here, we investigate hydrogel geometry, microstructure, and local electric fields as alternative mechanisms for controlling transdermal delivery. arxiv.abstract: The rapid growth of the space economy, alongside increasing orbital congestion and debris, is driving demand for reliable on-orbit transportation of large and non-cooperative objects. arxiv.title: Dispersive Tree Agreements for Multi-Robot Coordination
arxiv.abstract: Multi-robot coordination of nonlinear systems is naturally formulated as joint-space optimal control subject to constraints over groups of robots. arxiv.abstract: Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) stands as a fundamental challenge in robotics, essential for enabling autonomous agents to execute complex, long-horizon tasks in diverse environments. arxiv.abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D semantic maps have emerged as a key spatial memory representation for long-horizon robot autonomy, enabling robots to reason about objects, their spatial relationships, and past observations across time. arxiv.title: Skeleton-Grounded Latent Action Model for Robot World Models
arxiv.abstract: Robot world models simulate how environments evolve in response to robot actions. Latent action models enable learning dynamics from videos by encoding visual transitions as proxy actions. arxiv.abstract: Tactile sensing provides robots with contact information difficult to obtain from vision alone. arxiv.title: OP-Print: Tracing Membership Imprints in On-Policy Self-Distillation
arxiv.abstract: On-policy distillation has been widely adopted for alleviating the distribution mismatch of off-policy distillation. Self-distillation further removes the need for an external teacher by using the student's own outputs, enhanced with extra context or demonstrations, as supervision. arxiv.abstract: Counterfactual explanation methods have been introduced for unimodal settings, with dedicated frameworks for tabular, timeseries, text, and image data, yet no post-hoc method has been designed for classifiers that learn from multimodal inputs. arxiv.abstract: Control evaluations measure whether safeguards can prevent an AI model from causing undesired outcomes even when it is intentionally trying to do so. arxiv.title: VERA: A Responsible AI Dashboard for Assessing LLM Deployments in Light of the EU AI Act
arxiv.abstract: Institutions that deploy large language models in regulated settings often need technical evidence of responsible AI practices before approving a deployment. arxiv.abstract: Research on sycophancy asks whether large language models (LLMs) bend towards what their users want to hear. We ask the reverse question: when an LLM is confident, consistent, and wrong, do users bend towards it? arxiv.abstract: Masked diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, but their efficiency depends on which predictions are committed. arxiv.abstract: In the post-API landscape, social-media profiling has become inexpensive and automated: Large Language Models (LLMs) can extract structured information from unstructured content and deduce attributes users never disclosed. arxiv.abstract: Online Policy Distillation (OPD) often outperforms offline methods such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) by training on trajectories sampled directly from the student. arxiv.abstract: Controllable 3D part generation is pivotal for digital asset creation, yet existing methods lack the flexibility to accommodate diverse user workflows requiring varying levels of control. arxiv.abstract: Frontier coding agents are becoming increasingly adept at 3D modeling. arxiv.title: Gate3DGen: A Pre-processing Model that Selectively Purifies Real-World Images for 3D Generation
arxiv.abstract: Single-image 3D generation has achieved high fidelity on curated benchmarks, yet degrades sharply on real-world images with uneven illumination, blur, and occlusions. arxiv.title: OmniRay: Camera-Agnostic Monocular 3D Reconstruction with Composite Ray Fields
arxiv.abstract: Monocular models recover 3D geometry from a single image in one pass, but most assume a pinhole camera and produce distorted geometry on the wide-angle imagery produced by fisheye and panoramic lenses. arxiv.title: GigaBench: Benchmarking Learnable Representations for Gigapixel Image Compression and Super-Resolution
arxiv.abstract: Learnable Representations (LRs) can fit parametric families of functions to diverse kinds of signals. arxiv.title: UniVOE: A Removal-Driven Framework for Interaction-Aware Universal Video Object Editing
arxiv.abstract: Video object removal and injection are reciprocal editing operations between object-present and object-absent video states, yet they differ substantially in training difficulty. arxiv.title: WorldForge V2: Eliciting Camera-Trajectory Alignment in Video Diffusion Models
arxiv.abstract: Video diffusion models have learned rich 3D/4D priors, making them promising for scene generation and video re-rendering. However, their use in spatial tasks is limited by imprecise camera control, spatial and temporal inconsistencies, and entangled camera motion with scene dynamics. arxiv.title: HiP3R: Hierarchical Pose Graphs for Long-Horizon 3D Reconstruction
arxiv.abstract: Feed-forward models accurately estimate camera motion and 3D geometry from short video windows. However, computational and memory costs prevent direct inference on sequences containing thousands of frames. Long videos must therefore be processed as overlapping chunks. arxiv.abstract: This paper studies category-level RGB-D object pose estimation, which recovers an object's 3D rotation and translation without instance-specific CAD models or reference views. arxiv.title: CellTrack-Bench: Microscopic Cell Tracking Benchmark for Vision-Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Large language models have shown outstanding performance on text-first tasks such as coding, math, and writing. Recent efforts are shifting models' training to include scientific problems that often live in highly specialized domains beyond text, such as protein structure and biological images. arxiv.title: Squaring-the-Sphere: Distortion-Free and Seamless Panorama Generation via CubeAtlas
arxiv.abstract: Generating 360-degree panoramas requires both local perspective fidelity and global spherical continuity. hf_papers.title: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
hf_papers.abstract: A decoder-free, action-conditioned world model predicts next-screen representations to verify GUI transitions and detect hijacked screens with high accuracy and low latency.

hf_papers.title: DONIC: Generalist Dexterous Bimanual Tracking Control from Human Demonstrations
hf_papers.abstract: DONIC is a generalist bimanual tracker trained on diverse human-motion data that uses reinforcement learning with recycled demonstrations and per-hand rewards to achieve high success on unseen objects without fine-tuning.

hf_papers.title: Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience
hf_papers.abstract: Ropedia W0 is a world foundation model for cross-embodiment loco-manipulation that unifies human and robot data via kinematic representations and achieves state-of-the-art results across diverse benchmarks.

hf_papers.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
hf_papers.abstract: HexaShell is a coding agent that controls a dual-arm robot via vision and self-written tools, achieving state-of-the-art results on RoboDojo but struggling with contact-heavy tasks.

hf_papers.title: S-Agent 2.0: Spatial Reasoning with a General Coding Agent
hf_papers.abstract: S-Agent 2.0 improves spatial reasoning by integrating a persistent scene memory and plain-language interpretation into a coding agent with 3D perception tools.

hf_papers.title: Editing Images into Reusable Layers via Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation
hf_papers.abstract: LayerEditor unifies instruction-guided image editing with reusable RGBA layer generation via joint token modeling and edit-prior distillation, enabling precise local manipulation and layer reuse.

hf_papers.title: ScaleNav: Scalable Internet Video Pretraining for Language-Conditioned Local Navigation
hf_papers.abstract: ScaleNav learns goal-directed visual dynamics from internet egocentric videos to generate robot actions for language-conditioned local navigation, achieving high success rates in simulation and real-world deployment.

hf_papers.title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
hf_papers.abstract: WildAWM synthesizes controllable computer-use environments and tasks to train general agents via interaction, improving out-of-distribution performance across web, CLI, and GUI benchmarks.
ai_keywords: Agent World Model in the Wild

hf_papers.title: VLA-Rolling: Fewer Denoising Steps, Better Control via Adaptive Action Reuse
hf_papers.abstract: VLA-Rolling improves vision-language-action model efficiency by reusing discarded action tails with adaptive denoising budgets, reducing inference cost and boosting success rates.

hf_papers.title: Scaling in Games: Continued Pre-Training For Embodied Agents In Diverse Virtual Worlds
hf_papers.abstract: Continued pre-training across data scale, diversity, and model size improves embodied learning in virtual worlds but reveals limits in distant-world generalization, motivating richer training beyond imitation.

hf_papers.title: BridgeWAM: Bridging Video and Action Experts via Latent Bridge Queries
hf_papers.abstract: BridgeWAM decouples video and action experts via latent bridge queries to improve action prediction efficiency and generalization in world action models.

hf_papers.title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
hf_papers.abstract: Researchers introduce AnyGoal to evaluate whether world models can generalize dynamics to unseen combinations of familiar states and actions for planning.

hf_papers.title: Execution Before Memory: Diagnosing Memory Failures in Video World Models
hf_papers.abstract: MIST separates scene setup from change execution to isolate memory failures in video world models, and M3-Agent improves instruction execution to significantly boost benchmark scores.

hf_papers.title: LaLa-World: Scaling Latent World Models with Natural Language Actions
hf_papers.abstract: LaLa-World is a language-conditioned latent world model that jointly learns from diverse simulation, robot, and video data to enable efficient model-predictive planning and policy initialization.

hf_papers.title: Self-Distilling Future Video Representations for World Action Models
hf_papers.abstract: FRED improves single-step future video representations in world action models through self-distillation and temporal conditioning, boosting robot policy performance on long-horizon and unseen tasks.

hf_papers.title: ALPS: Visual State Encoders for World Models
hf_papers.abstract: ALPS is a pretrained visual encoder that unifies physical-state prediction, language alignment, and pixel reconstruction to serve as a shared foundation for world models.

hf_papers.title: From VLM Planners to Robotic Agents: Self-Evolving Harnesses for History-Dependent Manipulation
hf_papers.abstract: SERA improves long-horizon robotic manipulation by using an editable harness to maintain task context and evolve planning through execution feedback, paired with a fixed low-level VLA executor.

hf_papers.title: LLM2R: From Large Language Models to 3D Reassemblers
hf_papers.abstract: LLM2R treats 3D part assembly as sequence modeling with a pretrained decoder-only LLM, using geometric tokens and learnable summary tokens to predict all part poses in a single pass with improved scalability and accuracy.

hf_papers.title: AffordanceWAM: Affordance-Aware Joint World-Action Modeling for Robot Manipulation
hf_papers.abstract: AffordanceWAM uses affordance representations from human videos to jointly predict future scenes and robot actions, improving manipulation transfer without human action labels.

hf_papers.title: Consistent Distribution Matching for Data-Free Diffusion Distillation
hf_papers.abstract: Consistent Distribution Matching accelerates diffusion and flow models via simulation-free, data-free distillation that unifies generation and score estimation, achieving strong one-step and few-step results.

hf_papers.title: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
hf_papers.abstract: PAPAV defines five core capabilities for multimodal embodied agents and highlights gaps in evaluation and physical constraints when moving from digital to robotic settings.

hf_papers.title: Frechet Forcing: Training Long-Horizon Streaming World Models from Short Clips
hf_papers.abstract: Fréchet Forcing fine-tunes streaming video world models using self-generated rollouts and real-data statistics to prevent long-horizon drift without requiring teachers or long videos.

hf_papers.title: OfficeTown: Generative Organizations for Evolving Agent Intelligence
hf_papers.abstract: OfficeTown is a generative simulation framework that creates persistent professional organizations to generate work-grounded training data and evaluation benchmarks for AI agents.

hf_papers.title: Agentic World Action Models
hf_papers.abstract: Recent world action models provide visual foresight and future prediction for robot manipulation, but lack explicit mechanisms for compositional skill reuse. Agentic robotics combines code-based planning and reasoning with reusable skills, but often lacks predictive grounding in physical dynamics. hf_papers.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video

items.title: ScaleNav：互联网视频预训练语言导航动作
items.summary: 从互联网第一视角视频学习目标导向视觉动力学，再对齐机器人动作；论文报告其在仿真与真机语言条件局部导航中的结果。[端到端VLA]

items.title: VLA-Rolling：复用动作尾部降低去噪成本
items.summary: 通过自适应去噪预算复用滚动规划中被丢弃的动作尾部，目标是在减少 VLA 推理开销的同时提升控制成功率。[端到端VLA]

items.title: Echo：动作与任务状态联合去噪
items.summary: 把任务成功/失败状态信号与动作生成耦合，帮助 VLA 在执行中判断何时停止、恢复或重规划，减少额外细粒度标注依赖。[端到端VLA]

items.title: DONIC：从人类示范学习通用双臂跟踪控制
items.summary: 结合多样人类运动数据、示范回收与按手设计的奖励，以 RL 实现无需微调的未见物体双臂跟踪；代码已公开。[控制层·RL]

items.title: OpenTac：可定制、可扩展的 3D 触觉生态
items.summary: 提出可规模化部署的电阻式触觉皮肤与完整生态，利用可变形覆盖层把切向载荷转成空间压力分布，面向下游控制与学习。[感知层]

items.title: VecTile：低成本柔性三轴力触觉阵列
items.summary: 6 mm 薄的柔性触觉阵列可测三自由度力，补足常见低成本阵列只能测法向力的限制，服务抓取稳定性和接触修正。[感知层]

items.title: DiffDreamer：世界模型耦合可微仿真的四旋翼控制
items.summary: 面向动态门竞速，把世界模型的未来想象与可微仿真耦合，试图分离环境演化和机器人动力学以抑制模型偏差。[控制层·世界模型]

items.title: LaLa-World：自然语言动作的潜空间世界模型
items.summary: 联合仿真、机器人和视频数据，以语言作为动作接口训练潜世界模型，支持高效模型预测控制与策略初始化；代码已公开。[控制层·世界模型]

items.title: 跨会话室内导航的稀疏拓扑度量图
items.summary: 以可通行空间的拓扑连通结构补足易受场景变化影响的局部测量，面向跨会话室内导航的训练免适配引导。[感知层]

items.title: S-Agent 2.0：带持久场景记忆的空间推理
items.summary: 把持续场景记忆、自然语言解释和 3D 感知工具接入通用编码智能体，增强对空间关系的持续推理；代码已公开。[感知层]

items.title: SERA：随执行反馈演化的长视野操作规划
items.summary: 在固定低层 VLA 执行器上增加可编辑 harness，维护任务上下文并按执行反馈更新规划，处理具历史依赖的操作任务。[规划层]

items.title: AnyGoal：检验世界模型是否超越专家轨迹
items.summary: 提出评估，考察世界模型能否对熟悉状态与动作的未见组合泛化，为面向规划的动力学组合泛化提供更直接的检验。[控制层·世界模型]
